demeter dulce de leche — eau de cologne.description: Dulce de leche, Spanish for sweet milk, is a South American confection made by slow-cooking sweet milk until it’s highly concentrated, while the gentle heat creates new flavor compounds using the same gourmet process that browns meats and vegetables. Demeter Dulce De Leche perfume is delightfully faithful to the real flavor; much like caramel but less sweet, with fascinating undertones and perhaps a bit powdery. Creamy milk is very noticeable, and hints of coconut, wheat and spice complete the subtleties of this delicious scent.

demeter lilac — eau de cologne en spray.description: Demeter Lilac is a 2009 fragrance released as part of the brand’s Spring Is in the Air collection. This single-note scent is designed to evoke the intoxicating aroma of these gorgeous purple blooms that signify the full swing of spring. Fans of this scent say it smells exactly like a lilac bush, so you can have that new beginnings feeling all year long.
